title: Financial Consultancy Services in Nepal | Lalitpur Advisory
metaDescription: Specialized financial consultancy in Nepal based in Lalitpur. Expert solutions in business financial planning, budgeting, bookkeeping setup, and tax compliance.
h1: Strategic Financial Consultancy for Businesses & Individuals in Nepal
directAnswer: Lalitpur Financial Advisory provides strategic financial consultancy, corporate budgeting, cash-flow structuring, bookkeeping setup, and tax-compliance guidance for businesses, startups, and individuals across all seven provinces of Nepal. Headquartered in Lalitpur, we bridge the gap between daily operations and high-level commercial decision-making.
author: Lalitpur Advisory Research Desk

sections.contentHtml:
We deliver comprehensive, independent financial management tailored to the commercial and regulatory landscape of Nepal. Our engagements focus on four foundational pillars:

1. Financial Consultancy Services

Comprehensive operational budgeting, internal financial controls, and strategic decision support for growing organizations.

Explore Core Consultancy →

2. Personal Financial Planning

Household budgeting, cash-flow optimization, 3-6 month emergency fund sizing, and debt reduction strategies in NPR.

Explore Personal Finance →

3. Business Financial Consulting

Rolling cash-flow forecasting, working capital optimization, and break-even analysis for SMEs and startups.

Explore Business Consulting →

4. Accounting & Bookkeeping

Transaction recording, bank reconciliations, VAT books maintenance, and pre-audit file preparation.

Explore Bookkeeping →

5. Tax Planning & Compliance

Lawful structuring, advance tax installment planning (Poush, Chaitra, Ashad), e-TDS reconciliation, and IRD filing.

Explore Tax Support →

6. Business Registration & Licensing

Pvt Ltd company incorporation at OCR, Municipal Ward permitting, PAN/VAT setup, and post-incorporation Share Lagat.

Explore Business Setup →

sections.h2: Who We Help: Structured Client Pathways
sections.contentHtml:
Our consultancy provides dedicated advisory tracks depending on your commercial maturity:

Individuals & Households

Structuring family budgets in NPR, building emergency reserves, managing loan EMIs, and setting quantifiable long-term wealth milestones.

Startups & Entrepreneurs

Evaluating business structures, navigating OCR incorporation, setting up initial charts of accounts, and modeling cash runway.

Established Businesses & SMEs

Overcoming cash crunches, optimizing working capital, streamlining bookkeeping, preparing for bank credit, and audit coordination.

Professional Delineation: Lalitpur Financial Advisory operates as an independent financial and management consultancy. In compliance with the Nepal Chartered Accountants Act 2053, statutory external audits are conducted exclusively by licensed ICAN members. We prepare businesses for audits and coordinate with independent audit practices, but we do not issue statutory audit opinions or provide regulated legal court representation.

faqs.question: Where is Lalitpur Financial Advisory located?
faqs.answer: Our headquarters is situated in Lalitpur Metropolitan City (Pulchowk-Kumaripati commercial area), providing physical consultations in Kathmandu Valley and digital advisory across all seven provinces of Nepal.

faqs.question: How do we begin working together?
faqs.answer: You can start by booking an initial discovery consultation via our website or contacting our Lalitpur advisory desk. We review your requirements and propose a project or retained consulting scope.
